rows.task: Every return the app shows is a time-weighted return — his decision, 2026-10-04
rows.todo: HIS WORDS, in the note that came back with Net worth file 1: "All return should be True Weighted Return and not Dietz return." Not a Modified Dietz return, not a money-weighted return, not a change in balance. The method: split the period at every deposit or withdrawal; each piece's growth = value just before the next one ÷ value just after the last; multiply the pieces and take 1 off. No figure when the start day is not recorded, or when a deposit is recorded and the value that day is not. A yearly rate only for a period longer than a year. WHERE IT APPLIES: MK-NW-O-008 thePerformance (the Performance tab and each account's return — Modified Dietz today, with a money-weighted rate standing in where it refuses); MK-NW-O-003 theNetWorth (the return on cash + investments — a change in balance today, so a deposit reads as earned: 42.32% where 10.97% is right in the reviewer's case). ONE FACT HE ASKED TO BE TOLD: the app records one value a day, taken after that day's deposits. So the value just before a deposit is that day's value less the deposit; where no value was recorded on the day, there is no figure.
